summary: AECOM filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $500 million revolving credit facility with Bank of America and other lenders. The facility matures June 9, 2028, with no borrowings outstanding at signing. Interest rates are SOFR or base rate plus margins, with unused commitment fees. The obligations are guaranteed by subsidiaries and secured by substantially all assets. The filing is a routine debt agreement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved.
